question: How fast can the fastest eruption clouds race across the land?
answer: Eruption clouds race at 50 to 700 km/h, so they can spread hazardous material fast. In Plinian eruptions, very viscous magma builds towering columns, and when a column collapses it races out as flows. The fastest is 14 times quicker than the slowest.
move: Eruption clouds race at 50 to 700 km/h, spreading danger fast.
